name: pantheon
description: Makes Claude an orchestrator that delegates to specialist roles on Codex or native Claude agents, chosen per profile, with an auto-opening /pantheon panel for roles, activity and jobs.

profile.title: Active profile
profile.description: Picks the active Pantheon profile. A profile set in ~/.claude/pantheon.json or <repo>/.claude/pantheon.json overrides this choice. Custom profiles defined in those files are accepted.
